name: Alexander Blockx
intro: Alexander Blockx is a tall young player from Belgium. He is only 21. He is already the best player in his country.
story: Alexander started tennis at age four. He tagged along to his big brother's lessons. The coach asked if he wanted to try. He said yes, and he never stopped! In 2023 he won the junior title at the Australian Open.

funFacts.text: His dad was a hurdle runner. His mom was a swimmer.
He is a tennis trivia whiz. He remembers old match scores.
As a kid fan, he got a photo with star Daniil Medvedev. Now they share the stage at events.
He had the same coach from age 4 until this year. That is 16 years!
He won 42 of 45 matches in under-12 tournaments.
This spring he reached the semifinals of a big tournament in Madrid.
He is 6 feet 4 inches tall. That is a lot of reach!

watchFor: Watch his booming serve come down fast and bounce up high.

notes: Birth 2005-04-08 Antwerp, R-handed/2HBH, 193 cm, parents Oleg (hurdles) and Natalia (swimmer), 2023 AO boys' title over Learner Tien, junior No. 1, coach Cassiers 2010-Apr 2026, 2026 Madrid SF, Belgian No. 1, started at 4 via brother's lessons: confirmed on Wikipedia.
